labels.org.opencontainers.image.description: The Brave browser is a fast, private and secure web browser for PC, Mac and mobile.
labels.org.opencontainers.image.title: Brave

dockerfile.amd64:
# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1
FROM ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/baseimage-selkies:debiantrixie

ENV LSIO_FIRST_PARTY=true

# set version label
ARG BUILD_DATE
ARG VERSION
LABEL build_version="Linuxserver.io version:- ${VERSION} Build-date:- ${BUILD_DATE}"
LABEL maintainer="thelamer"

# title
ENV TITLE=Brave \
    PIXELFLUX_WAYLAND=true \
    NO_DECOR=true

RUN \
  echo "**** add icon ****" && \
  curl -o \
    /usr/share/selkies/www/icon.png \
    https://raw.githubusercontent.com/linuxserver/docker-templates/master/linuxserver.io/img/brave-logo.png && \
  echo "**** install packages ****" && \
  curl -fsSLo \
    /usr/share/keyrings/brave-browser-archive-keyring.gpg \
    https://brave-browser-apt-release.s3.brave.com/brave-browser-archive-keyring.gpg && \
  echo \
    "deb [signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/brave-browser-archive-keyring.gpg] https://brave-browser-apt-release.s3.brave.com/ stable main" \
    > /etc/apt/sources.list.d/brave-browser-release.list && \
  apt-get update && \
  apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    brave-browser && \
  echo "**** cleanup ****" && \
  printf \
    "Linuxserver.io version: ${VERSION}\nBuild-date: ${BUILD_DATE}" \
    > /build_version && \
  apt-get autoclean && \
  rm -rf \
    /config/.cache \
    /var/lib/apt/lists/* \
    /var/tmp/* \
    /tmp/*

# add local files
COPY /root /

# ports and volumes
EXPOSE 3001

VOLUME /config

notes.upstream:
Release v1.99.55 (Chromium 157.0.8103.39)

# Android

Pick the `APK` suitable for your device's architecture.

# iOS

`brave-core-ios-1.99.55.*` contains Brave for iOS.

# Linux

`DEB` and `RPM` packages attached below, details at https://brave.com/linux

# macOS

`Brave-*-*.dmg` or `Brave-*-*.pkg` will install this version.
macOS 12 and above are supported as per https://support.brave.app/hc/en-us/articles/360021357112-What-are-the-system-requirements-to-install-Brave

# Windows

`Brave*Setup.exe` will fetch and install the latest available version for your CPU architecture from our update servers.
Windows 10 and above are supported as per https://support.brave.app/hc/en-us/articles/360021357112-What-are-the-system-requirements-to-install-Brave

# Release Notes

### Leo

 - Improved Leo to present a list of choices when it needs clarification on a task. ([#59649](https://github.com/brave/brave-browser/issues/59649))
 - Improved suggested follow-up prompts. ([#59650](https://github.com/brave/brave-browser/issues/59650))
 - Updated AI Chat models. ([#59701](https://github.com/brave/brave-browser/issues/59701))
 - Fixed issue where a compromised Leo conversation frame could approve AI Chat tool-use requests without a direct user action. ([#59703](https://github.com/brave/brave-browser/issues/59703))

### General

 - Re-enabled "Allow split view drag-and-drop on left or right edge of window" setting under brave://settings/braveContent. ([#49752](https://github.com/brave/brave-browser/issues/49752))
 - Updated icon in URL bar to magnifying glass for Brave Search. ([#58178](https://github.com/brave/brave-browser/issues/58178))
 - Upgraded Chromium to 157.0.8103.39. ([#60882](https://github.com/brave/brave-browser/issues/60882)) ([Changelog for 157.0.8103.39](https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src/+log/156.0.8078.80..157.0.8103.39?pretty=fuller&n=1000))

# Origin Release Notes

 - Re-enabled "Allow split view drag-and-drop on left or right edge of window" setting under brave://settings/braveContent. ([#49752](https://github.com/brave/brave-browser/issues/49752))
 - Updated icon in URL bar to magnifying glass for Brave Search. ([#58178](https://github.com/brave/brave-browser/issues/58178))
 - Upgraded Chromium to 157.0.8103.39. ([#60882](https://github.com/brave/brave-browser/issues/60882)) ([Changelog for 157.0.8103.39](https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src/+log/156.0.8078.80..157.0.8103.39?pretty=fuller&n=1000))
